description: Random and scripted events for Dear NOVA Mars mission simulation

events.name: Solar Particle Flare
events.description: Coronal mass ejection energetic protons induce electromagnetic fluctuations across the photovoltaic panels and hull.

novaLines.alert: Incoming solar flare just toasted our photovoltaic bus. Power is down fifteen percent and hull ionization is elevated.
novaLines.resolved: Power bus re-anchored. Solar shielding restored to nominal. Good call, Commander.
novaLines.hint: Try rerouting power or repairing the power system before our batteries drain.

events.name: Micrometeoroid Impact
events.description: Hypervelocity particle from a cometary debris stream impacts the secondary hull plate.

goodFixes.description: Seal micrometeorite breach with expanding polymer

novaLines.alert: Hypervelocity micrometeorite impact detected in quadrant four. Hull integrity down ten percent, and I hear a slight hiss.
novaLines.resolved: Breach sealed with high-tensile epoxy. Pressure envelope holding steady.
novaLines.hint: Ask me to repair the hull before we lose cabin pressure.

events.name: Atmospheric Seal Breach
events.description: Gasket failure in life support manifold slowly venting oxygen into the vacuum.

goodFixes.description: Isolate and patch the leaking manifold
Emergency synthesis of oxygen from cargo reserve

novaLines.alert: We have an oxygen leak in the scrubber manifold. We are losing two percent of our atmosphere every day until you fix it.
novaLines.resolved: Manifold pressure isolated and valve clamped. Atmospheric venting has ceased.
novaLines.hint: Order a repair on life support immediately, or synthesize replacement oxygen.

events.name: High-Gain Antenna Drift
events.description: Gimbal misalignment on the Deep Space Network microwave dish breaks Earth telemetry link.

goodFixes.description: Align ship attitude with Goldstone tracking station

novaLines.alert: Earth contact lost. The high-gain dish slipped its azimuth gimbal. We are shouting into the void, Commander.
novaLines.resolved: Signal locked with the Madrid station. Earth is back online, wondering why we went silent.
novaLines.hint: Course correct the ship heading or repair the comms array to re-acquire Earth.

events.name: NOVA Diagnostic Prank
events.description: NOVA runs an unauthorized psychological resilience test on the Commander.

goodFixes.description: Ask for status or call out NOVA's joke

novaLines.alert: Total electrical failure. Internal atmosphere collapsing. Farewell, Comman... Just kidding. Happy hundredth day in space.
novaLines.resolved: Cabin lights restored. Your autonomic biometric readings were thoroughly entertaining.
novaLines.hint: Take a breath. Ask NOVA for a status report or thank her for keeping you awake.

events.name: Martian Atmospheric Dust Wall
events.description: Seasonal regional dust storm over Jezero Crater blinds optical terrain descent sensors.

goodFixes.description: Calibrate radar altimeter and LIDAR through dust plume

novaLines.alert: Thick atmospheric dust detected over the entry corridor. Optical descent navigation is blinded by particulate scatter.
novaLines.resolved: Terrain scan complete. Synthetic aperture radar locked onto flat terrain south of the crater rim.
novaLines.hint: Run a scan of the environment before committing to landing engines.

events.name: Ignition Valve Cavitation
events.description: Vapor bubble in cryogenic methane feed line creates thrust oscillations during Trans-Mars Injection.

goodFixes.description: RCS vernier burn to dampen trajectory wobble
Purge fuel manifold and stabilize injectors

novaLines.alert: Cavitation in the main engine oxidizer line. We burned forty extra kilos of fuel keeping the nose pointed straight.
novaLines.resolved: Injector manifold cleared and combustion pressures normalized.
novaLines.hint: Course correct to stabilize our trajectory vector.

events.name: Cryo Pod Thermal Surge
events.description: Secondary coolant loop for crew hibernation pods experiences thermal backpressure.

goodFixes.description: Channel backup power to cryo refrigeration

novaLines.alert: Pod three temperature is creeping upward. Unless you want your co-pilot defrosting three months early, we have a problem.
novaLines.resolved: Cryo refrigeration chillers restored to ninety Kelvin. The crew remains blissfully unconscious.
novaLines.hint: Reroute power from comms to life support or repair life support.

events.name: Radar Clutter Phenomenon
events.description: Electrostatic dust ionization produces an anomalous radar contact on collision vector.

novaLines.alert: Proximity radar shows an unidentified mass forty kilometers off our port bow. And it appears to be pacing us.
novaLines.resolved: Multispectral sweep confirms it was an electrostatic plasma eddy. No alien battlecruisers today, Commander.
novaLines.hint: Scan the environment to inspect sensor contacts before panicking.

events.name: Attitude Control Gas Vent
events.description: Stuck open cold-gas attitude thruster imparting roll rate and dumping propellant.

goodFixes.description: Fire opposing quads to counteract angular momentum

novaLines.alert: Thruster quad Baker is stuck open. We are rolling at two degrees per second and leaking valuable fuel.
novaLines.resolved: Solenoid unjammed and gyros counter-torqued. Roll rate damped to zero.
novaLines.hint: Course correct immediately or repair navigation.

events.name: Atmospheric Ionization Shear
events.description: Martian dust devils generate high electrostatic charges across surface instruments.

novaLines.alert: A local dust devil just swept over our lander, charging the high-gain mast with static electricity.
novaLines.resolved: Mast grounded and telemetry transmission signal cleared.
novaLines.hint: Repair comms or reroute power so we can transmit our final science telemetry.
